title: Common-exponent generator-normalized Tate coefficient comparison
statement: Let A,B be finite commutative rings, φ:A→B a unital map, N>0 killing A and B, and N invertible on a scheme T. There is a specified CoefficientLineComparison for φ at exponents N,N on T: its roots map is the identity, its sheaf map is the adjoint of reductionEtaleTateMap, and its derived isomorphism is reductionEtaleTateIso.

proof.text: Use the published isomorphism theorem for the adjoint Tate scalar map. At equal positive exponents the root power N/N is one. The generator clause is the defining normalized root-generator equation. The derived isomorphism is the actual derived reduction Tate isomorphism and has the required normalization by its defining equation.
